# wallix.bastion.device_service

Manage services of a device on a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.0.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Create, update or delete a service (SSH, RDP, ...) of a device on a WALLIX Bastion.
- Equivalent of the `wallix-bastion_device_service` Terraform resource.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="parameter-api-version"></a>**api_version** | `str` | Version of the Bastion REST API to use, `v3.8` or `v3.12`.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_API_VERSION` environment variable is used, then `v3.12`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-host"></a>**bastion_host** | `str` | Hostname or IP address of the WALLIX Bastion.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_HOST` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-password"></a>**bastion_password** | `str` | Password of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PASSWORD` environment variable is used.<br>One of [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password) or [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token) is required. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-port"></a>**bastion_port** | `int` | HTTPS port of the WALLIX Bastion API.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PORT` environment variable is used, then `443`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-timeout"></a>**bastion_timeout** | `int` | Timeout in seconds of each HTTP request to the Bastion API.<br><br>Default: `30` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-token"></a>**bastion_token** | `str` | API key of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). Takes precedence over [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_TOKEN` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-user"></a>**bastion_user** | `str` | User to authenticate with. With [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token), the user the API key belongs to.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_USER` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-connection-policy"></a>**connection_policy** | `str` | Name of the connection policy of the service, for example `SSH` or `RDP`.<br>Required when the service does not exist yet and [`state=present`](#parameter-state). |
| <a id="parameter-csrf-enabled"></a>**csrf_enabled** | `bool` | Send the CSRF token the Bastion issues at login (Bastion 12.0.3 and later).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_CSRF_ENABLED` environment variable is used, then `true`. |
| <a id="parameter-device-name"></a>**device_name** | `str` / required | Name of the device the service belongs to. The device must exist. |
| <a id="parameter-global-domains"></a>**global_domains** | `list / elements=str` | Names of the global domains whose accounts can be used on this service. Order does not matter.<br>When set, replaces all the global domains of the service. Use `[]` to remove them all. |
| <a id="parameter-port"></a>**port** | `int` | TCP port of the service on the device.<br>Required when the service does not exist yet and [`state=present`](#parameter-state). |
| <a id="parameter-protocol"></a>**protocol** | `str` | Protocol of the service.<br>Required when the service does not exist yet and [`state=present`](#parameter-state).<br>Cannot be changed once the service exists; delete and recreate the service instead.<br><br>Choices: `SSH`, `RAWTCPIP`, `RDP`, `RLOGIN`, `TELNET`, `VNC` |
| <a id="parameter-service-name"></a>**service_name** | `str` / required | Name of the service. Identifies the service on the device. |
| <a id="parameter-state"></a>**state** | `str` | Whether the service should exist.<br><br>Choices: `present` (default), `absent` |
| <a id="parameter-subprotocols"></a>**subprotocols** | `list / elements=str` | Sub-protocols allowed on the service. Order does not matter.<br>Only for [`protocol=SSH`](#parameter-protocol) (`SSH_SHELL_SESSION`, `SSH_SCP_UP`, ...) and [`protocol=RDP`](#parameter-protocol) (`RDP_CLIPBOARD_UP`, `RDP_DRIVE`, ...).<br>The Bastion requires at least one when creating an SSH or RDP service. |
| <a id="parameter-validate-certs"></a>**validate_certs** | `bool` | Whether to validate the Bastion's TLS certificate.<br>Only disable this for test instances with self-signed certificates.<br>If not set, `WALLIX_BASTION_VALIDATE_CERTS` is used, then the inverse of `WALLIX_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`, then `true`. |

## Attributes

| Attribute | Support | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | full | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | full | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- Options left unset keep their current value on the Bastion.
- With [`state=absent`](#parameter-state), a missing device is not an error.
- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Declare the SSH service of a Linux server
  wallix.bastion.device_service:
    device_name: srv-linux-01
    service_name: SSH
    connection_policy: SSH
    protocol: SSH
    port: 22
    subprotocols:
      - SSH_SHELL_SESSION
      - SSH_SCP_UP
      - SSH_SCP_DOWN

- name: Move the service to another port
  wallix.bastion.device_service:
    device_name: srv-linux-01
    service_name: SSH
    port: 2222

- name: Remove a service
  wallix.bastion.device_service:
    device_name: srv-linux-01
    service_name: SSH
    state: absent
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-changed-fields"></a>**changed_fields** | `list / elements=str` | Options that differed from the Bastion and were updated.<br><br>Returned: when the service already existed and [`state=present`](#parameter-state)<br><br>Sample: `["port"]` |
| <a id="return-service"></a>**service** | `dict` | The service as returned by the Bastion API after the change.<br>In check mode, the expected service. `null` when [`state=absent`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-service) |

<a id="sample-service"></a>

### Sample of `service`

```yaml
connection_policy: SSH
global_domains: []
id: 1a0f6db068020af9005056b66c8b
port: 22
protocol: SSH
service_name: SSH
subprotocols:
- SSH_SHELL_SESSION
- SSH_SCP_UP
- SSH_SCP_DOWN
url: /services/1a0f6db068020af9005056b66c8b
```
